issue_11.title: Stage 2 Real Pilot Input Sourcing Checklist
issue_11.finding: Issue #11 remains sourcing/approval only and explicitly forbids Stage 2 execution, Codex runs, frozen pilot plans, traces, evidence-gate reruns, fixture/fake evidence, and performance claims before real inputs are approved.

requested_final_goal: Complete Hermes SkillEval v0.3 Stage 2 real Codex pilot evidence chain by first preparing a real, human-approved 4-task pilot input package, then stopping for approval before freezing and running exactly 12 real Codex runs.

cli_surface.python -m hermes_skilleval.cli --help: PASS with PYTHONPATH=src; lists skillsbench-validate, skillsbench-plan, skillsbench-matrix, and v0.3-evidence-gate.
cli_surface.python -m hermes_skilleval.cli skillsben: INVALID_CHOICE; this CLI does not expose skillsbench-freeze-plan.
PASS; this is the available plan/freezing command surface.
cli_surface.python -m hermes_skilleval.cli v0.3-evid: PASS; accepts external and live plan/report inputs.

repository_findings.fixture_only_data_root_rejected: tests/fixtures/live_agent/skillsbench_tiny has only fixture evidence and must not be used as real Stage 2 evidence.
why_not_valid_real_stage2_package: They are not already a SkillsBench-style data root with tasks.jsonl, skills.jsonl, manifest.json, routed_predictions.json, and oracle_qualification.jsonl.
They use verifier: skill_selection rather than deterministic task-output verifier artifacts with code/config/input hashes.
Their gold_skills are oracle labels; using those to create routed predictions would violate the no-oracle-derived routed-predictions rule.
No human approval marker for this exact 4-task pilot package was found.

missing_required_fields: human approval marker for the exact selected 4 tasks
deterministic verifier code/config/input artifacts for each selected task
oracle qualification artifact generated against deterministic verifier output
routed predictions generated by an approved router/config rather than manual, ad hoc, or oracle-derived labels
stable global skill registry package bound to routed predictions

phase2_deterministic_verifiers.reason: No valid 4-task real pilot source package exists to attach deterministic verifier packages to. The local benchmark YAML verifier field is skill_selection, not a deterministic task-output verifier package.

phase3_global_registry_and_oracle_skills.reason: A global registry can be derived only after the selected task/skill package is approved and leakage-checked. Oracle qualification cannot be non-fabricated without deterministic verifier runs.

existing_exporters.external-export-predictions: Available only for external SkillRouter prediction artifacts, not Stage 2 pilot task routed predictions.

why_manual_generation_rejected: The request forbids hand-written routed predictions.
The request forbids oracle-label-derived routed predictions.
The request forbids manual/ad_hoc label sources.

separate_minimal_ops_patch_proposal.scope: Expose an approved frozen router/config over the approved Stage 2 global skill registry to emit routed_predictions.json with router_id, config_hash, top_k, generation provenance, global_skill_registry_hash, oracle_labels_read=false, label_source=router_predictions, and per-task prediction hashes.
non_goals: Do not freeze a pilot plan.
Do not tune thresholds or train routers.
Do not change scorer, matrix, evidence-gate, or verifier semantics.
Do not read oracle labels or task gold labels while generating routed predictions.

phase5_validate_input_package.reason: No input package was built. Running the validator without real approved inputs would only repeat the known missing-field failure and could not produce READY_FOR_REVIEW_NOT_EXECUTED.

blocked_definition_of_done_items: Prepare and validate a real/human-approved 4-task pilot input package.
Execute exactly 4 tasks x 3 conditions x 1 trial = 12 real Codex runs.
Generate live-agent pilot report, traces, and hashes.
Rerun v0.3-evidence-gate with existing Stage 1 external evidence and new Stage 2 pilot evidence.
remaining_blockers: Human approval is needed for the exact 4 selected tasks before they can be treated as real Stage 2 pilot inputs.
A real Stage 2 SkillsBench-style data root or manifest must be provided or generated from approved source tasks without leaking task_id/oracle/gold labels into public prompts.
Deterministic verifier code/config/input artifacts and expected output schemas must exist for all 4 tasks.
Oracle qualification must be run and recorded against deterministic verifier output for all 4 tasks.
A stable global skill registry with public text leakage checks must be created for the selected skills.
A Stage 2 routed prediction exporter is missing; implement the separate minimal ops patch before attempting Phase 5 readiness.
recommended_next_step: Open a separate minimal ops patch named ops/export-stage2-pilot-routed-predictions, or provide a human-approved 4-task real input package plus deterministic verifiers/oracle qualification/registry/routed predictions for validation.
